theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_ret_normal_space_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (T T' : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ T = Module.finrank ℝ T' → ‖T'.starProjection - T.starProjection‖ ≤ 1 / 2 → ∀ n ∈ T'ᗮ, ∃ e ∈ Tᗮ, e - T'.starProjection e = n ∧ ‖e‖ ≤ 2 * ‖n‖
